why: A side-scrolling collect-and-dodge runner best dramatizes grabbing only legitimate scoped charges while avoiding everything off-scope at launch-speed volume.
title: Ramp Express: Scope Sprint
subtitle: Catch the exact charge your agent card was made for—dodge everything else.
closing_stat: You safely captured {score} scoped charges without blowing the budget.

feature_explainer.headline: Ramp Agent Cards (Ramp Express)
bullets: Ramp issues scoped, single-purpose agent cards.
Each card can only be used for the exact charge it was created for.
Agents collect legitimate scoped charges that match their card.
Open cards, duplicate charges, fraudulent vendors, and expired authorization tokens are off-scope risks.

art_style: Flat vibrant cartoon with bold outlines and a wild-west express-runner feel, reimagined as a high-speed finance trail with card rails, receipt tumbleweeds, and Ramp-green accents.
